title: Title slide: Dutch Uncle John's Exegesis on Genesis 1:1, Part 1
summary: Title slide for the first part of the Genesis 1:1 study, showing the presenter seated in front of a large world map with the title "In Beginning, Part 1" and the number 1 over the video picture.

text.text: Dutch Uncle John’s Exegesis on Genesis 1:1, Part 1

pictures.description: Video still of the presenter, a man with glasses and short grey hair in a white t-shirt, seated on a tan couch and gesturing with both hands spread wide. Behind him hangs a large wall map of the world showing South America, the South Atlantic Ocean, Africa and the Indian Ocean. Green text "In Beginning, Part 1" and the green number 1 are overlaid.
pictures.text_in_picture: BRAZIL, ARGENTINA, CHILE, SOUTH ATLANTIC OCEAN, INDIAN OCEAN (map labels); In Beginning, Part 1
